assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: A1 English lesson photo, 3:2 landscape. Create one REAL complete monthly wall calendar on a clean wooden-framed whiteboard, photographed straight on, daylight and natural texture. NOT a schedule, NOT a book or two pages. A proper May2023 calendar, Monday-first, with EVERY DATE from1 through31 exactly once. Numeric month heading only: 05 / 2023. Exactly seven equal columns and five rows. ROW1: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7. ROW2: 8 9 10 11 12 13 14. ROW3: 15 16 17 18 19 20 21. ROW4: 22 23 24 25 26 27 28. ROW5: 29 30 31 then four empty cells. Each number large and legible, consistent black dry-erase marker lettering, located near top centre of its cell. First-row cells also each have one small simple drawing below the number: home under1, school under2, tree/park under3, home under4, school under5, tree/park under6, home under7. No activity drawings on the other rows. ONE dark-blue hand-drawn pen loop encloses the complete first cell (date1 and home drawing), denoting Monday; all other cells unmarked. Circle should have slightly uneven ink and an overlapping end stroke. Board fills nearly the entire frame; all31 dates, all7 columns and all5 rows are visible, readable and unclipped. Clear black grid, familiar real monthly calendar proportions, no unnecessary background or props. Preserve exact sequential numbers and count. No letters or words anywhere: no weekday names, weekday initials, translations, captions, subtitles, brand names, legends, or answer phrases. Only numeric heading05 / 2023 and the dates1–31 are permitted. One coherent physical monthly calendar photograph, no collage, no split pages, no blank date rows.
